name: collaboration-types-split
goal: The Collaboration type file is within the 220-line limit again: the source history contracts live in their own model file and every public type is still exported from the original

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: packages/collaboration/src/models/Collaboration.types.ts counts 227 lines (skipBlankLines, skipComments) against max-lines 220 since SourceCommitFacts and the SourceHistoryAdapter contracts grew it. Expected: within 220, every exported type and import unchanged. info scaffolds lists no declaration-only model shape, so the split is a hand-written models/*.types.ts beside the existing one.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: cd packages/collaboration && bun run lint -> exit 1: Collaboration.types.ts 225:1 error File has too many lines (227). Maximum allowed is 220 max-lines. The existing lint rule is the regression check; no test, limit or config was added or changed. Before sha256 9b5a66924ef70ee9e4f93d70e46eba71b18136f8e82400b3b8ccfd52e93d4a58.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Moved SourceCommitFacts, SourceHistoryCommit, SourceHistoryPageInput, SourceHistoryPage and SourceHistoryAdapter byte for byte, comments included, into models/SourceHistory.types.ts; Collaboration.types.ts re-exports them with export type. No importer, limit, lint config or budget ledger edited. units index --write: 1 added (collaboration.model.source-history-types), 1 updated, reciprocal import/reexport dependencies.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same command, cd packages/collaboration && bun run lint -> exit 0 (188 and 47 counted lines). tsc --noEmit exit 0 with no importer edited. Against HEAD: 31 of 31 exported names, 31 of 31 declarations written identically, 31 type-identity comparisons with 0 problems, index 39 of 39 names; a scratch mutant (facts required, one comment dropped) is rejected. bun run check:collaboration exit 0: 12 files, 42 tests, audit passed. After sha256 0c2c9a6e58d58f5ededac2b4d4522463063f32b63a37fe1e97b6b16583a6683c and 04100920827b20f9244b72d11e4a70b48647bb9dc8151942003e200fc679ae9e.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
